---
title: theme-void
subtitle: "Void theme: no axes, no grid, no panel background."
category: Themes
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---



## Usage

```typst
theme-void()
```



## Returns

Theme dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/theme-void-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  theme: theme-void(),
)
```
